title: Written on the Wall II Conjecture 316
statement: Let G be a finite simple connected graph and P its pendant vertices. If the average degree of the complement of G is at most |P|, then all inclusion-minimal total dominating sets of G have the same size.

counterexample.description: A finite connected simple graph satisfying the complement-average-degree premise, together with two inclusion-minimal total dominating sets of different cardinalities.
